task.title: Create a Payment Order
task.shortdesc: Create a PayPal order to initiate the checkout flow and receive a buyer approval URL.

ul.li: A valid OAuth 2.0 Bearer token — see
Item details and total amount to charge the buyer

step.cmd: Send a POST request to /v2/checkout/orders with the order details.
Parse the order id and approval URL from the response.
step.stepresult: Store the order id. Redirect the buyer to the approve link URL.

step.cmd: Redirect the buyer to the PayPal approval page.
step.info: Extract the link where rel equals approve and redirect the buyer's browser to that URL. The buyer will log in to PayPal and confirm the payment.

result.p: The order is created with status CREATED. After buyer approval, the status changes to APPROVED and you can proceed to capture.

postreq.p: See to collect funds after buyer approval.
